mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS above their 3-month moving averages) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE below 4.0%), the tight labor market supports sustained corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 102.5 (current level 103.0258) indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 102.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance amid rising price pressures, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated future rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 300 and FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market characterized by nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 0.5% over three months supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% over three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 20200) indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 20200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
